newsitem.title: ISRAEL: Jordan's Kabariti to meet Arafat in PLO-ruled Gaza. [CORRECTED 08:55 GMT 12/1]
newsitem.headline: Jordan's Kabariti to meet Arafat in PLO-ruled Gaza. [CORRECTED 08:55 GMT 12/1]

text.p: A senior PLO official said on Saturday that Jordanian Prime Minister Abdul-Karim al-Kabariti would meet Palestinian President Yasser Arafat on Sunday in self-ruled Gaza.
"Kabariti will visit Gaza to hold talks with Arafat over the latest developments in PLO-Israel talks," Arafat adviser Nabil Abu Rdainah told Reuters.
"This is part of the Jordanian-Egyptian-Palestinian consultation on the peace process," he said.
Arafat held talks with Egyptian President Hosni Mubarak in Cairo on Saturday (corrects from Wednesday).

U.S.-mediated talks between Israel and the Palestinians over a long-overdue Israeli troop redeployment in the West Bank town of Hebron are deadlocked over a timetable for further Israeli pullbacks from West Bank lands after Hebron.
